changeSet.sql: UPDATE medication_administration ma SET ma.status = (CASE WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'in-progress' THEN 'INPROGRESS' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'not-done' THEN 'NOTDONE' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'on-hold' THEN 'ONHOLD' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'completed' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'entered-in-error' THEN 'ENTEREDINERROR' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS CHAR(11)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ma.status COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LIMIT 1) = 'stopped' THEN 'STOPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END);

UPDATE medication_administration SET status = (CASE WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'in-progress' THEN 'INPROGRESS' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'not-done' THEN 'NOTDONE' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'on-hold' THEN 'ONHOLD' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'completed' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'entered-in-error' THEN 'ENTEREDINERROR' WHEN (SELECT crt.code FROM concept_reference_term crt JOIN concept_reference_map crm ON crt.concept_reference_term_id = crm.concept_reference_term_id WHERE CAST(crm.concept_id AS VARCHAR) = medication_administration.status LIMIT 1) = 'stopped' THEN 'STOPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END);
